title: Vulture Eye
html:
Monster drop: Boneyard Vulture

What it’s for

An enchant reagent. Each infuse (one carat more) and each re-enchant to one of these uses one:

  • of Seeking (gems: Diamond + Diamond + Diamond)
  • of Insight (gems: Diamond + Iolite + Iolite)
  • Diamond rings and pendants (their gem: Gem Diamond)

Dropped by Vulture: Carrion Vulture, Giant Vulture, Boneyard Vulture, about 1 kill in 500 (an elite 1 in 50).

See Reforging & reagents for the odds and fees, and Reagents for every reagent.
